01 / Agent-led systems

FinX Intelligence Agent

  • Implemented
  • Planned

A scheduled research pipeline that turns a defined social network into scored ticker evidence and a weekly market-intelligence report.

Accounts→Posts→Scoring→Weekly metrics→Report
Case study
Problem

Chronological feeds reward recency while hiding recurring signals, disagreement and week-to-week movement.

What I built

Collection from a curated account list, Claude scoring of each ticker mention, weekly metrics, a static HTML dashboard and an email summary.

Next edge

An offline fixture so a weekly report can be inspected without the live database. A separate read-only analyst chat is planned, not built.

  • Python
  • Claude scoring
  • Weekly report
  • Dashboard
Repository ↗

01 / Agent-led systems

OutboundOS

  • Implemented

A governed operating system for repeatable outbound execution, with explicit operator control before anything becomes action.

Schedule→Research→Proposal→Review→Output
Case study
Problem

One-off automations create activity without a durable workflow, shared state or a trustworthy approval boundary.

What I built

Scheduled runs, deterministic research fixtures, pending proposals, explicit review, approved materialisation and an append-only event log.

Next edge

Replace the fixture researcher with a live source while keeping the same approval gate. Employer operating logic stays out of this repository.

  • Python
  • Approval gate
  • Event log
  • 6 tests
Repository ↗

01 / Agent-led systems

AI Agent Traffic Listener

  • Implemented

A privacy-conscious server-side listener that measures AI-agent visits without creating a new dataset of ordinary human traffic.

Request→Detect→Classify→Event→Report
Case study
Problem

Browser analytics undercount crawlers and live retrieval agents, leaving an emerging discovery surface invisible.

What I built

A configurable agent registry, unknown-agent discovery, privacy-minimised events, asynchronous writes and an insert-only schema.

Next edge

Check registry labels against vendor documentation before using them for access control. This measures agent traffic. It does not measure how a brand is represented inside model answers.

  • Node.js
  • Next.js pattern
  • Supabase
  • 24 tests
Repository ↗

02 / Semantic intelligence

Campaign Resonance Engine

  • Implemented
  • Experimental

Find companies whose own language provides evidence that a campaign premise is likely to resonate.

Premise→Language→Search→Evidence→Audience
Case study
Problem

Firmographic targeting says who a company is, but rarely whether it is already expressing the problem or worldview behind a campaign.

What I built

Reviewed prospect-language queries, passage-level semantic retrieval, the best evidence per signal and breadth-first company ranking.

Next edge

Replace the deterministic demonstration encoder with a production embedding provider. The retrieval and evidence contracts stay the same.

  • Python
  • Embeddings
  • Evidence
  • 5 tests
Repository ↗

02 / Semantic intelligence

Semantic Market Profiler

  • Implemented
  • Experimental
  • Planned

Turn an open-ended market question into an operator-reviewed source plan, evidence-backed profiles and an inspectable qualification.

Question→Source plan→Evidence→Profile→Qualify
Case study
Problem

Useful market attributes often live in unstructured text and cannot be bought as a clean database field.

What I built

Editable source plans and semantic signals, an approval gate, evidence-backed profiles, post-qualification and natural-language querying.

Next edge

Connect a real collector and a production embedding provider behind the same approval gate. Raw web collection is not in this slice.

  • Python
  • Operator control
  • 2 examples
  • 7 tests
Repository ↗

03 / Network analysis

GraphGTM

  • Implemented
  • Planned

Map a buyer ecosystem, identify its communities and bridges, then search the people and evidence inside it.

Network→Communities→Bridges→Semantic search→Entry points
Case study
Problem

Account lists flatten a market that actually spreads through communities, influence paths and connector relationships.

What I built

PageRank, betweenness, Louvain communities, participation and role labels, plus evidence-preserving concept search over a synthetic graph.

Next edge

An interactive explorer for the same synthetic graph. This repository does not contain a private social graph.

  • Python
  • NetworkX
  • Louvain
  • 5 tests
